synthesis.procedure: NaOH (2 mmol, 0.08 g) in methanol (10 ml) was added in five portions to a boiling solution of Nd(ClO4)3·nH2O (8 mmol, from 1.346 g Nd2O3) in methanol (10 ml). A solution of 2,6-diformyl-4-methylphenol (4 mmol, 0.6566 g) and NaOH (4 mmol, 0.16 g) in methanol (150 ml) was then added to the boiling solution in 20 ml portions. After each addition of sodium cresolate, the mixture was boiled until approximately 10 ml of solution remained before adding the next 20 ml portion. The pH of the mixture at this point was approximately 6.5. The final mixture was boiled until 5 ml of solution remained, then cooled and filtered, and approximately 10 ml of ethanol was added. The resulting mixture was left in an open flask at room temperature. Crystallization began after 3 d and was allowed a further 2 d to complete. Yellow blocks of (I) were recovered in 20% yield (based on LnIII). The crystals lost solvent and crumbled to an amorphous solid on exposure to air. Caution: perchlorate compounds are potentially explosive.
synthesis.temperature: boiling methanol during additions; room temperature crystallization
synthesis.time: crystallization onset after 3 d, completed after a further 2 d
synthesis.vessel_or_method: open-flask ligand-controlled hydrolysis and evaporation from methanol/ethanol
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled, filtered, ~10 ml ethanol added; left in an open flask at room temperature to give yellow blocks; crystals lose solvent and crumble in air
